entities.name: PdxJ pyridoxine synthase
observations: The 238-residue query sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q3V7J9 from Anaplasma marginale.
The query contains the PdxJ domain PF03740.21 spanning residues 3–231.
PdxJ catalyzes pyridoxine 5'-phosphate formation in the cytoplasm.
Sequence-derived molecular weight is 26,187.91 Da and theoretical pI is 6.64.

entities.name: PdxJ pyridoxine synthesis
observations: 3-amino-2-oxopropyl phosphate plus 1-deoxy-D-xylulose 5-phosphate yields pyridoxine 5'-phosphate, phosphate, 2 water, and a proton; Rhea RHEA:15265.
This is a ring-closure reaction in pyridoxine 5'-phosphate biosynthesis.

entities.name: Pyridoxine 5'-phosphate biosynthesis
observations: PdxJ performs the final step, step 5/5, of the pathway from D-erythrose 4-phosphate.
